cards.title: Valid Parentheses
cards.prompt: Given a string containing only () [] {}, determine whether every opening bracket is closed by the correct type in the correct order.
cards.answer: Use a stack for opening brackets and a HashMap that maps each closing bracket to its matching opening bracket.
cards.complexity: Time: O(n). Space: O(n) worst case for the stack; the HashMap is O(1).

cards.title: Two Sum
cards.prompt: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target. You may assume exactly one solution exists and cannot use the same element twice.
cards.answer: As you scan the array, use a HashMap to remember each number and its index. For the current number, look up its complement: target minus the current number.
cards.complexity: Time: O(n). Space: O(n) for the HashMap.
